hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.ex|*.exs) mix format "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *.rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0

echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|git reset --hard|git push .*--force' && echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command — enumerate exact resolved paths/refs and get explicit user confirmation first' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -f mix.exs ] || exit 0; out=$(mix compile --warnings-as-errors 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: mix compile --warnings-as-errors is failing — fix it or explain why before stopping (run the 'gate' skill for the full protocol):" >&2; echo "$out" | tail -40 >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
